title: Better 3D Mace
description: This Project Brings The Minecraft Mace To Life By Changing The Old Boring Vanilla Texture And Making It 3D!
body:
A Texture Pack That Changes The Mace Texture To 3D! Changing It From The Boring Vanilla Look.
Perfect For PVP By Taking Only A Small Space On Your Screen, And All The Beauty For Survival Players To Explore With!
